eligibility_modes.plain_language: Any registered voter in this jurisdiction may request a mail ballot.

freshness_note: Request methods and deadlines are verified daily during the active mail-ballot request window.

request_methods.fallback_if_unavailable: Use the printable form or contact the help line for the official alternate request path.
request_methods.plain_language: Submit your request through the online portal before 5:00 PM local time.
